verdict.rationale: IP India's own Forms & Official Fees page publishes downloadable statutory forms and fee amounts by filing mode, which suggests a non-online filing path, but nothing in the pack documents where or how to submit on paper, by mail, or by fax. Missing for 10: exact postal addresses of the filing offices, fax numbers, explicit paper or mail submission instructions, any statement that this rail serves as a fallback when e-filing is down, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, a paper, fax, or mail fallback rail is published with the exact addresses, numbers, and forms, so the task can still be completed when the online flow is unavailable

citations.quote: Official fees are published as the statutory First Schedule with downloadable forms on the "Forms & Official Fees" page — amounts by filing mode
